transform.qualification: Baseline numeric world-axis rotation and uniform scale on selected faces, explicit pivot, no-op/cancel/history and native persistence.
limits: One box, two connected top faces, Z rotation and uniform scale in actual Studio. Other axes/mirror/input edge cases are pure tests. No drag/local frame support.

loopRegression.qualification: Loop ratio preview replaces topology from one baseline; Apply owns one step, Cancel preserves source, native reopen preserves accepted cage.
limits: One closed quad box in actual Studio. Existing edge-loop slide is not implemented; no B-rep or smooth dimensional claim.
